$comment: Nested patches (PLAN D26-D28). base = TrueDOP 2025 over the whole city, imagery only, the overview for fly-overs. Site patches carry LoD2 and lend their photo to the roofs. Boxes are lon/lat, so they are axis-aligned in Web Mercator, which is what the WMS serves and MapLibre draws.

patches.$comment: Whole of Berlin, about 47 x 39 km ground. At 4096 px that is about 11 m/px: enough for the overview, and the screen at that zoom is coarser still.
Hero (D28): degewo car park Waldsassener Strasse 31 and the surrounding degewo estate, 1.5 x 1.5 km. Shipped at about 0.37 m/px; roof colours measured from the 0.2 m source.

sites.$comment: D29: every named degewo estate and every positioned BVG site, generated from the sites bake by aoi.site_patches(); overlapping boxes merge. Marzahn: central 2.5 km only (its outline is the whole Ortsteil).
